name: servicesartisans-rge
description: MCP server pour le Registre RGE francais — recherche d'artisans RGE certifies (ADEME), calcul deterministe MaPrimeRenov' 2026 et CEE 2026, et liste des aides cumulables pour un geste de renovation energetique. Source de verite : annuaire-entreprises RGE officiel (sync hebdo), Licence Etalab 2.0.

tools.name: lookup_rge
tools.description: Lookup an RGE-certified artisan by SIRET (14 digits). Returns canonical fiche metadata: name, address, active qualifications, certifying organizations, validity dates.

tools.name: search_rge
tools.description: Search RGE-certified artisans by city and metier (specialty). Up to 50 ranked matches by RGE validity date.

tools.name: get_bareme_mpr
tools.description: Returns the MaPrimeRenov' 2026 subsidy amount for a given geste and menage_categorie. Deterministic snapshot.

tools.name: get_aides_for_geste
tools.description: Returns the list of cumulable financial aids (MaPrimeRenov, CEE, eco-PTZ, TVA 5,5%, regional bonuses) for a renovation geste.

auth.notes: Optional Bearer token gated by MCP_BEARER_TOKEN env. Public read-only by default.

attribution: Source : ServicesArtisans / Registre RGE ADEME (Licence Etalab 2.0)
